answer: In an AI economy, the Byzantine Fault Tolerance (BFT) consensus mechanism offers a robust defense against fake-identity attacks. By establishing a decentralized network of agents, each with unique digital signatures, a thread of trust is woven, allowing only legitimate agents to participate. As the network reaches its zenith, a single malicious agent attempting to create multiple identities would struggle to convincingly replicate the digital signatures of a single, legitimate entity, rendering the attack futile, much like a pearl that loses its luster without its original shell.
